RATE-1.name: NOTHING_MEASURED
RATE-1.description: Raised when a limit is expressed as a share of a line nothing has measured.

RATE-2.name: NO_ZONE
RATE-2.description: Raised when a schedule is asked for and nothing says which zone the clients would read it in.

RATE-3.name: LIMIT_UNREADABLE
RATE-3.description: Raised when what was asked for could not be read as a limit, a window or a cap.

RATE-4.name: NOTHING_TO_LIMIT
RATE-4.description: Raised when there is no download client to limit.

RATE-5.name: NOTHING_TO_PAUSE
RATE-5.description: Raised when there is no download client to pause or resume.

RATE-6.name: PAUSING_MOVED
RATE-6.description: Raised where pausing or resuming the download clients names an offer that is not the one a fresh look at them builds.
